description: This source file provides utility functions for converting between file paths and file URLs, handling platform-specific path normalization, and generating safe filenames within the Chromium project.

methods.name: FilePathToFileURL
methods.description: Converts a base::FilePath to a file URL string, handling platform-specific encoding and special characters.

methods.name: FileURLToFilePath
methods.description: Converts a file URL (GURL) to a base::FilePath, decoding percent-encodings and normalizing path separators based on platform.

methods.name: GenerateSafeFileName
methods.description: Ensures the filename has a safe extension based on MIME type and modifies the filename if it is a reserved name on Windows.

methods.name: IsReservedNameOnWindows
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a reserved name on Windows, including device names and special filenames.
